inclusion_authorization: Supplied for inclusion by the project owner: the eight classic .sc2 cities on 2026-10-05, the owner's own city Adaven on 2026-10-06, and Bonanza Gap and Old Bottle on 2026-11-07. Every included city ships as a fully imported native .sc2d save. Magnolia Township supplied for inclusion on 2026-11-08; curated as Silver Ridge. Old Bottle is now Juniper Basin and Lawndale is now Harbor Palms.
